task_description.overview: Simulate the response of a target seismometer by removing the original instrument poles-zeros and applying the desired poles-zeros model.
steps: Load raw or pre-corrected seismic waveform data into a Stream object.
Define a PAZ (poles, zeros, gain, sensitivity) dictionary for the original and desired instrument.
Call Stream.simulate() with parameters: paz_remove (original PAZ) and paz_simulate (target PAZ).
Compare or plot the original and simulated traces to verify the transformation.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Load the seismic waveform from {seismic_waveform}. Remove the original instrument response using paz_remove={paz_remove} and simulate the target instrument response (paz_1hz) using corn_freq_2_paz={corn_freq_2_paz}. Generate a comparison plot with the original data and the simulated data (normalized). Save the response simulation plot to {simulated_response_plot} and the simulated response to {simulated_response}.
